name: Scythe Mod
description: Adds three powerful endgame scythes for PvP and survival: the Bloody Scythe with bleeding and Blood Harvest, the Plague Scythe with poison auras and missing-health scaling, and the Withering Scythe with wither effects and partial armor bypass. Includes custom abilities, HUD timers, advancements, recipes, Bloody Essence drops, configuration, and English/Russian localization.
